name: WF-053 Audit Trail & Decision Evidence Gate

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const events=Array.isArray(input.events)?input.events:Array.isArray(input.records)?input.records:[]; const norm=v=>String(v??'').trim(); const lower=v=>norm(v).toLowerCase(); const allowed=new Set(['created','normalized','qualified','underwriting_decision','offer_decision','seller_decision','buyer_decision','transaction_decision','closing_decision','post_close_decision','crm_update','system_exception','human_approval']); const requiredForHuman=['actor_id','decision_at','decision','reason']; const requiredForExternal=['action','decision']; const missing=[]; const invalid=[]; const duplicateKeys=[]; const seen=new Map(); const audit=[]; events.forEach((e,i)=>{const key=norm(e.event_id??e.audit_id??e.idempotency_key??e.request_id); const type=lower(e.event_type??e.type); const actor=norm(e.actor_id??e.approver_id??e.user_id); const decision=norm(e.decision??e.outcome??e.result); const action=norm(e.action??e.requested_action); const reason=norm(e.reason??e.notes??e.evidence_reference); const timestamp=norm(e.decision_at??e.occurred_at??e.created_at); if(!key)missing.push({record_index:i,type:'missing_event_id',severity:'blocking',message:'Audit event requires a deterministic event identifier.'}); else if(seen.has(key))duplicateKeys.push({record_index:i,event_id:key,first_record_index:seen.get(key)}); else seen.set(key,i); if(!allowed.has(type))invalid.push({record_index:i,type:'unsupported_event_type',severity:'blocking',event_type:type||null,message:'Audit event type is outside the supported evidence contract.'}); const req=type==='human_approval'?requiredForHuman:action?requiredForExternal:['decision','timestamp']; const absent=req.filter(f=>f==='actor_id'? !actor:f==='decision_at'? !timestamp:f==='decision'? !decision:f==='reason'? !reason:f==='action'? !action:!norm(e[f])); if(absent.length)missing.push({record_index:i,type:'missing_decision_evidence',severity:'blocking',missing_fields:absent,message:'Required decision/audit evidence is missing.'}); audit.push({record_index:i,event_id:key||null,event_type:type||null,actor_id:actor||null,action:action||null,decision:decision||null,reason:reason||null,decision_at:timestamp||null,source_workflow:e.source_workflow??e.workflow??null,entity_id:e.entity_id??e.deal_id??e.lead_id??e.property_id??null});}); const blocking=[...missing,...invalid]; const health=blocking.length?'blocked':duplicateKeys.length?'needs_review':'ready'; const next=health==='ready'?'Preserve the audit record as the evidence trail for downstream decisions and external actions.':health==='blocked'?'Complete missing decision evidence and correct unsupported audit events before treating the trail as authoritative.':'Review duplicate event identifiers and reconcile them before relying on the audit trail for replay or reporting.'; return[{json:{ok:health==='ready',audit_health:health,event_count:events.length,blocking_issue_count:blocking.length,duplicate_event_count:duplicateKeys.length,missing_evidence:missing,invalid_events:invalid,duplicate_event_keys:duplicateKeys,audit_trail:audit,decision_evidence_coverage:events.length?Math.round(((events.length-blocking.length)/events.length)*10000)/100:100,next_action:next,policy:{audit_and_evidence_only:true,no_automatic_external_side_effects:true,no_automatic_outreach:true,no_legal_validation:true,no_title_clearance_claim:true,no_funding_verification_claim:true}}}];
